clauses.reason: The order exempts Louis A. Simon, Supervising Architect of the Public Buildings Administration, Federal Works Agency, from compulsory retirement for age under section 204 of the act of June 30, 1932, and fixes the period in its own words: "for a period of six months ending November 30, 1941". The recital says Louis A. Simon had been exempted from compulsory retirement for age for periods totaling four years by Executive Orders No. 7581 of March 19, 1937, No. 7824 of February 25, 1938, No. 8046 of February 11, 1939, and No. 8369 of March 7, 1940; those earlier orders precede this one and are not events of it. The end is recorded as November 30, 1941 (1941-11-30), inclusive: the exemption runs through that day. The exclusive reading, under which it ends when that day begins, is the alternative. MOMMSEN-I recheck: Predecessor EO 8046 APP Treasuiy / GPO Treasury in the agency name; unselected contextual predecessor, no altered operative grant or date. Its actual end is May 31, 1940, not the earlier rejected claim date 1937-05-31. EO 8369 actually ends May 31, 1941, not rejected 1938-05-31.
